text:
Sam (SilverStream PM): Quick sync — SilverStream POC kickoff tomorrow. Need final checks on pricing, SSO, and the security questionnaire. Who's owning which item?
Mia (AE): I can own pricing. They want an example run rate for ~50k requests/day + 5M tokens/month. Need a ballpark today so they can budget.
Jordan (SE): I’ll own infra. For the POC we plan Dedicated pool w/ 2x A10s; expect ~40ms p50 for typical gen. Need confirmation on egress, VPC peering, and whether they want private deployment.
Linh (Security): I started the security questionnaire — outstanding: KMS integration details, HSM availability, data residency, and SOC2 PDF. I’ll need the legal contact to attach the right docs.
Sam (SilverStream PM): @Linh they specifically called out HSM for key import. Is that something we can do on Hosted or only on Private/Dedicated?
Linh (Security): Enterprise-only. We offer customer-managed KMS in Private deployments. HSM-based key import requires signed LOA + SOC2 + legal review. Marking as a blocker for standard Hosted.
Mia (AE): Ok — SilverStream prefers committed pricing if there's an SLA. Can we prepare two proposals: Hosted metered and Dedicated 12-mo committed?
Jordan (SE): Yep. Preliminary numbers incoming. For Dedicated 12mo: infra compute + reserved support + networking uplift. I’ll draft a simple table and send in-thread.
Alex (Infra): Provisioning checklist: tenant name, desired region, CIDR for peering, SAML metadata (if SSO), and list of admin emails. Order: create tenant -> establish peering -> exchange certs -> enable SSO.
Ben (Solutions Eng): For quality/telemetry: enable token-level tracing and the eval harness. We recommend seeding the prefix cache with sample prompts and enabling per-route prompt folding for cost control.
Sam (SilverStream PM): They asked about latency SLOs — can we commit to 99p < 200ms for short prompts on Dedicated?
Jordan (SE): With 2x A10 + optimized kernels, p99 for 32-token responses is typically 180–220ms depending on concurrency. We can confidently promise p95 ~150ms; p99 would be contingent on provisioning additional capacity or burst pools.
Mia (AE): Action items: @Jordan provide detailed pricing + latency table; @Linh update sec questionnaire with HSM note and legal steps; @Alex send tenant provisioning checklist; @Ben share eval harness link. SilverStream expects answers by EOD tomorrow.
Linh (Security): I’ll add legal owner to the questionnaire and attach SOC2 artifact. I’ll mark HSM as "enterprise-only, requires LE contract" and include the expected legal timeline.
Jordan (SE): Quick network snippet to share with their netops:
```yaml
peering:
  cidr: 10.45.0.0/16
  routes: [10.45.0.0/16]
vpc: true
ports: [443]
```
Sam (SilverStream PM): Also need estimated lead time for Dedicated provisioning — they mentioned 3 weeks. Is that realistic?
Alex (Infra): 3 weeks is realistic if we get SAML metadata + peering info within 48 hours. If they delay those items add 1–2 weeks. Provisioning tasks: infra ticket, cert exchange, smoke tests.
Mia (AE): Another ask: can we provide cost protection if their usage spikes? Caps or alerts?
Ben (Solutions Eng): We can enable budget alerts + soft caps that throttle non-critical routes. Hard overage caps require gateway enforcement and a legal addendum — possible but needs procurement signoff.
Sam (SilverStream PM): Great — I’ll consolidate and email SilverStream with these answers. I’ll call out HSM as a likely enterprise-only blocker and present the two pricing options.
Mia (AE): +1. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Alex (Infra): I’ll DM Sam the tenant checklist and the peering template.
Jordan (SE): Sending the first-pass pricing table in 30 minutes.
Linh (Security): Uploaded updated questionnaire to the shared drive and pinged legal for the LOA path.
Sam (SilverStream PM): Closing loop here — will escalate if SilverStream insists on HSM for Hosted. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
